records.claim: Masked Majority Function training directly exercises extraction of a majority relation under visual interference, uncertainty and limited exposure time.
records.approved_public_wording: Attention Coach is closely aligned with goals involving signal extraction under visual interference and time pressure.
records.required_caveat: This construct fit does not establish improvement in every form of attention or everyday focus.

records.claim: MFT-M attention-control training has initial randomised evidence of transfer to selected attention-task conditions and verbal-learning acquisition trials.
records.approved_public_wording: Initial controlled research found transfer to selected attention measures and verbal-learning trials.
records.required_caveat: Independent replication, delayed follow-up and workflow outcomes remain needed.

records.claim: The Open Matrices Item Bank provides a validated, calibrated source of figural matrix items.
records.approved_public_wording: G Track uses matrix items from the validated Open Matrices Item Bank.
records.required_caveat: The selected G Track form, longitudinal sensitivity and score interpretation require implementation-specific validation; it is not an official IQ test.

records.claim: Complex-span tasks provide an established paradigm for maintaining information while performing an interleaved processing task.
records.approved_public_wording: The G Track complex-span-style task is based on established working-memory methods.
records.required_caveat: The exact G Track symmetry-span-style implementation remains provisional and non-diagnostic.

records.claim: Visual change-detection and binding paradigms provide an established basis for measuring feature and feature-location conjunction memory.
records.approved_public_wording: The G Track binding task is based on established visual working-memory binding paradigms.
records.required_caveat: The exact digital implementation and workflow relevance require separate validation.

records.claim: The current paired-task secondary analysis supports an exploratory four-component description of task-active control and a related but non-identical engagement-vigilance dimension.
records.approved_public_wording: G Track provides a provisional behavioural context estimate that becomes more informative across repeated sessions.
records.required_caveat: The profiles are not validated natural kinds, diagnoses, brain states or proven intervention selectors.
